get_component_status.description: Check one component of a status page, such as GitLab's 'CI/CD': whether it is operational, its status in each location, and any open incident or maintenance that affects it.
get_component_status.name: get_component_status

parameters.description: The status page's address, as you would open it in a browser, such as status.gitlab.com. A status.io/pages/... link works too.
